title: Osteomyelitis, lupus and blistering skin disease
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's condition (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for bullous pemphigoid.

HPI
Pt is a 61 y/o male presenting for follow-up of bullous pemphigoid. Pt reports ongoing pruritic and tense blisters on trunk and extremities. States he is adherent to current regimen. No new systemic symptoms or signs of infection reported.

Medication List
Doxycycline 100mg BID
Topical steroid cream as needed

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress. Skin: Multiple tense blisters noted on trunk and upper extremities. No signs of secondary infection. Otherwise NAD.

Assessment
1. Bullous pemphigoid. Pt is responding to current treatment but remains symptomatic.

Plan
1. Continue doxycycline BID.
2. Continue topical steroids on active lesions.
3. F/u in 4 weeks to monitor progression of bullous pemphigoid.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026
